notes.title: Rustled Pete Boss Editor
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42735054/48005f014b033937ef1d83b33485408a57a2fec2.png[/img]
Hello Rustled Pete players! I have been very quiet since Rustled Pete was released. I was mostly thinking about what to do next for the game in terms of content. After some thinking I figured it out! The game of course needs a boss editor, or as I like to call it, a Pete Factory!

You will be able to make your own Pete! Not only that, you will also be able to share it with the rest of the world through steam workshop!

I'm very excited for this millstone, I don't have a data picked yet, but the progress is steady with the occasional hiccups here and there. I will also share more details as I can!

Until then, make sure to beat up Pete as much as you like!

-lemon
